development_selection: R=40,100,400 screened at seeds 9000 with initial offsets (0.15m,0.01rad) and (-0.3m,-0.03rad), speeds 15/20/25. R=100 selected before any held-out evaluation.
full_policy_note: Standalone full-command training does not use LQR in its applied action or reward; existing completed 1M-step full policies are retained unchanged.
residual_policy_note: Train fresh five-seed 1M-per-seed residual policies with R=100 baseline. Earlier incomplete R=4 development residual run is excluded.
webots_lateral_force_dependent_slip: 4 * nominal_speed_m_s / 80000 in cylinder U direction; V coefficient zero
webots_calibration_acceptance: steady inferred per-axle small-slip stiffness within 15 percent of 80000 at 15/20/25 m/s; does not establish nonlinear Fiala equivalence
course_note: 125 m candidate fails chosen acceleration margin at tested speeds; explicitly different 220m development course passes. No ISO claim.
inference_evaluation: surrogate uses deterministic single-worker service-time scheduler; physical fusion uses real separate-process worker plus configured minimum simulated delay. Simulation and wall clocks remain separate.
